body:
## Outcome

Give web and mobile a shared spatial language while allowing compact Pro layouts and comfortable touch interfaces.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M1: Foundations and architecture · Priority: P0 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Extract spacing, radius, border, elevation, icon size, content width, grid, layer/z-index, and hit-target tokens from live components.
- Define comfortable and compact density profiles with named semantic roles; distinguish painted control size from interactive target area.
- Specify web responsive layout and native safe areas, keyboard avoidance, scroll behavior, orientation, tablets, and bottom-sheet sizing.
- Specify platform units and token resolution, including existing NativeWind rem roots, so extraction does not silently resize consumers.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Examples cover SDK documentation, marketing, touch app, dense Pro UI, and native sheets using the same token source.
- [ ] Mobile targets, compact desktop targets, and visible focus geometry meet the documented accessibility baseline without overlapping adjacent controls.
- [ ] Long content, large text, narrow viewports, safe areas, and on-screen keyboards remain usable; intentional overflow is specified.
- [ ] Each density or platform exception has a reason and a documented mapping, not a separate hand-maintained theme.

## Prerequisites

- #6 — Extract semantic design tokens and generate web/native color outputs
- #7 — Integrate Bloxwap fonts and define cross-platform typography

## References

- [Tokens](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/tokens)
- [App](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/apps/app/src/components/ui)
- [Pro](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/apps/pro/src/components/ui)
- [Native](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/ui-native)
- [Plain](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/plain-ui)

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
